results.question: How many PTO days do employees receive in their first year?
results.answer: Employees receive **15 PTOdays per year** during their first year of service. This is outlined in the PTO Accrual Rates table, which assigns 15 days annually to employees with 0–1 year of service. [Source: Paid Time Off (PTO) Policy]

results.question: How many days of PTO can employees carry over to the next year?
results.answer: The policy allows employees to carry over up to 10 unused PTO days into the following calendar year, as stated in [Excerpt 1 from: Paid Time Off (PTO) Policy]. Employees with more than 10 days will forfeit them by December 31st. [Source: PTO Policy]

results.question: How far in advance do I need to request more than two weeks of PTO?
results.answer: For PTO requests of 10 or more consecutive days, you must submit your request at least 15 business days in advance. [Source: Paid Time Off (PTO) Policy]

results.question: How many days of bereavement leave are provided for an immediate family member?
results.answer: Employees are entitled to up to 5 days of paid bereavement leave for the death of an immediate family member. [Source: Paid Time Off (PTO) Policy]
